summary.text: Charlene Lima is a Democratic member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives, representing District 14 since 1993, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026; Ballotpedia lists her as the only candidate. She is a teacher.

paragraphs.text: Charlene Lima earned a B.A. from the University of Rhode Island in 1975, and her professional experience includes working as a truant officer and as a teacher for the Providence School Department.
In the 2021-2022 session she was assigned to the Corporations, Innovation, Internet and Technology, Municipal Government, and Oversight committees.
She has a husband, Frank, according to Ballotpedia.
